title: aspidium ternatum
intro: Aspidium ternatum, commonly known as the three-lobed fern, is a species of fern in the family Aspleniaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium ternatum are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an antimicrobial agent, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
